newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Oct exports down 6.5 pct, re-exports up 9.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK Oct exports down 6.5 pct, re-exports up 9.8 pct.

text.p: The volume of domestic exports in October fell 6.5 percent on the year, while re-exports rose 9.8 percent, Census and Statistics Department data showed.
Total export volume rose 7.0 percent and import volume rose 7.3 percent.

The volume of domestic exports for the first ten months of 1996 decreased by 8.6 percent while the volume of re-exports leaped 7.6 percent. Total exports rose 4.8 percent and imports grew by 4.0 percent.
Prices of domestic exports slipped 0.6 percent in October 1996 from a year earlier and re-export prices decreased 0.8 percent, while import prices fell 2.0 percent.
Prices of domestic exports for the first ten months of 1996 were 0.4 percent higher, while those of re-exports eased 0.4 percent and import prices fell 1.2 percent.

Prices are based on unit values which do not take into account changes in the composition or quality of goods traded, except for some selected commodities for which specific price indices are available.
